text:
Anya: FYI I opened a PR to consolidate the console observability pages into a single 'Cost & Latency' rollup + add a short tracing-hook SDK example for trace propagation. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 

Anya: High level checklist: 1) verify metric names + units, 2) confirm SDK snippet matches v2 client, 3) update dashboard screenshots to 1200x600 and include alt text, 4) run link-checker and fix redirects. Pinged reviewers.

Mia: I can do screenshots — what camera/scale do you want? also do we need mobile variants?

Anya: Thanks — desktop 1200x600, crop tight to widget, include a small caption with time-range. Mobile optional (only if it changes layout).

Sam: Updated the SDK snippet to show trace header pass-through, putting it in the "tracing hook" subsection. Example (python):
```python
# attach trace context before calling the API
trace_id = get_current_trace_id()  # from our tracing lib
headers = {"traceparent": trace_id, "x-redwood-trace": trace_id}
resp = client.generate(prompt="Summarize the invoice", headers=headers)
```
Sam: note: the v2 client will forward headers if you pass them in the `headers=` arg — called this out in a note.

Leo: Quick metric question: which metric names should we reference? older pages used `console.latency.p50` and `console.cost.per_token` — we should standardize on metrics-v2 naming so users can match dashboards.

Anya: Use metrics-v2 names: `runtime.latency.p50_ms` and `runtime.cost_per_token_usd`. Add a short line explaining units (ms, USD/token) and show a tiny cost calc example.

docs-bot: link-checker report: 1 broken link -> /metrics/legacy (HTTP 404).

Sam: Fixed the broken link and force-pushed to branch (commit f2b3c4). pushed at 2076543250.

docs-bot: CI: samples lint / link-check / screenshot-size checks passed :white_check_mark:

Anya: Great — I'll merge after a final skim. Thanks everyone! :tada:
